property_summary: For all inputs where transfer(...) completes without revert, the reference contract C always returns true; the mutant returns false for those same successful inputs, so the returned boolean differs.

For every call to transfer(...) that completes (does not revert), the reference implementation always returns true, whereas the mutant returns false for the same completing calls; the test asserts that transfer(...) returns true (via try/catch) for all fuzzed inputs, which the mutant will violate for some inputs.
